title: Stasis Garden
description: A surreal black-background scene features a stylized woman in a flowing dress with a long, serpentine lower body coiled among glowing blue and purple flowers. She holds a luminous orb of swirling blue and purple energy while a vibrant rainbow drips from above, leading to a floating crystalline island with cascading blue waterfalls and two glowing spiral galaxies.
